findings.highlight: We're getting off topic. So, what's next for you?
findings.evidenceJa: 「話を戻しましょうか。で、どうするの。
findings.governingReading: The two entries form one quoted question ending at0:1.
findings.explanation: Rin’s speech lacks its opening mark.

findings.highlight: "Unbelievable. So you're not going to try to defeat any of the other Masters, unless they intend to do bad things.
findings.evidenceJa: 「呆れた。自分からマスターは倒さない、けど他のマスターが悪事を働いたら倒すっていうんだ。
findings.governingReading: Rin describes his exception: defeat another Master if they commit wrongdoing.
findings.explanation: Acting when others do harm becomes acting when they intend harm.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. I know they're just pretty words. But I can't think of anything else. I'm not changing my principles, no matter what you say."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ、都合がいいのは分かってる。けど、それ以外の方針は考えつかない。こればっかりはどんなに論破されても変えないからな」
findings.governingReading: He knows his rule is convenient/self-serving, but refuses to change it even if refuted.
findings.explanation: Convenient principles become just pretty words.

findings.highlight: But I promised to listen, so I need to hear her out.
findings.evidenceJa: が、男が断言した以上、聞かない訳にもいかないのだ。
findings.governingReading: As a man who asserted the policy, he must hear her objection.
findings.explanation: Having declared a stance becomes having promised to listen.

findings.highlight: "Not in a straight-up fight. That's the ultimate close-quarters Servant. There probably isn't anyone who can match it even among all the heroes of myth and legend. If Berserker attacks me, there's no escape."
findings.evidenceJa: 「正面からじゃ勝てないでしょうね。白兵戦ならアレは最強のサーヴァントよ。きっと歴代のサーヴァントの中でも、アレと並ぶヤツはいないと思う。わたしもバーサーカーに襲われたら逃げ延びる手段はないわ」
findings.governingReading: Rin thinks Berserker has no equal even among Servants of previous generations, within her close-combat comparison.
findings.explanation: Rin's comparison with past Servants expands to all heroes of myth and legend. It remains her tentative assessment of close-combat strength.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. My Archer's still recovering from a serious wound. That's going to take some time, but in the meantime, I'm not completely out of the fight.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そう。わたしのアーチャーは致命傷を受けて目下治療中。完全に回復するまで時間がかかるけど、それでも半人前ぐらいの活躍はできる筈よ。
findings.governingReading: Despite his injury, Archer should still contribute roughly half a full share; Rin pairs this with the other team's limitations.
findings.explanation: The English preserves Rin's case for an alliance while making Archer's expected partial contribution less explicit.
